description: Ministry of Defence - Award of the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal and Clasp to the Air Force Personnel
categorisation: This gazette announces personnel awards (Long Service Medals) to named individuals in the Sri Lanka Armed Services. It contains specific names, ranks, and service numbers but does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes. This fits Type 2 (People Gazette) as it focuses exclusively on personnel recognition without detailing their duties or responsibilities.
